judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A nicely lit cumulus tower glowing against darker cloud masses makes this a solid, keepable sky photo, though the framing and shadow detail keep it short of spectacular.
strengths: Strong tonal contrast between the sunlit tower and the dark surrounding cloud mass
Warm golden light gives the cumulus a sculpted, glowing edge
Clear, readable cloud structure with depth
weaknesses: Shadowed clouds are murky and slightly noisy
Composition is a bit static with the bright cloud pushed right of center
